scope: Exact-FP32 parity for first3 fixed complete DEV prefixes and at most4 greedy tokens per model; six model-prefix cases total. Not full192/all32 parity. Not a language/adoption score or checkpoint selector.
selection: Original frozen benchmark order, first3; not based on generated content or scores
endpointSelection: Same fixed resource milestone used by main evaluation, never numerical/language result selection
weightPolicy: Raw source float32 little-endian binary tensor extents+SHA; no 7-decimal or other weight rounding
specialIdAliasPolicy: API-only aliases user3/assistant4/turn5 preserve exact six-special vocabulary offset; inputs are frozen IDs; no prompt formatter/encoder called
comparisonPolicy: Identical Python-history inputs at every available short position; native-autoregressive agreement separately limited to shared histories through departure; independent unmodified Python/JS bytes and IDs stored even on divergence
failurePolicy: Report numerical threshold exceedance, argmax branch and margins without tolerance adjustment; retain failed-execution logs, do not conceal or repair output
